listing.name: Marvelous Personas
listing.summary: Replaces nearly all vanilla portraits with AI-generated artwork for each faction and adds extra portraits for notable characters.

"

Marvelous Personas

" is a portrait pack that replaces almost all

vanilla portraits (except AI portraits) and also adds few extra

portraits for each faction.

I made these portraits to use in my own campaigns.

After playing with them for a while i decided to share them with the

community in a mod format. I hope some people will like it

and use it in their game.

Portraits Showcase

Luddic / Vanilla + 3 Portraits[close]Pirate / Vanilla + 3 Portraits[close]Corporate / Vanilla + 6 Portraits[close]Diktat / Vanilla + 4 Portraits[close]Hegemony / Vanilla + 3 Portraits[close]League / Vanilla + 1 Portrait[close]Mercenary / Vanilla + 4 Portraits[close]Miscellaneous / Vanilla[close]!!SPOILER!! - Story/Quest/Notable Characters - !!SPOILER!![close]

Notes

- I used stabilityai's stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0 model with bunch of prompts and fine tuning in order to create these. Nothing else.

- I will try my best to keep this mod updated. I probably will add more additional portraits with updates.

- My mod is free and always will be. But if you would like to support me, please do visit my Patreon page linked below.

aiDescription: Replaces nearly all vanilla portraits in the game with new, hand-crafted ones for each faction. Adds extra portraits for several factions and includes unique designs for notable characters. The portraits are generated using AI and are intended to enhance the visual experience during interactions and campaigns.

changelog.1.2.0: Added support for new faction portraits and improved compatibility with existing mods.
changelog.1.1.0: Initial release with core portrait replacements and additional faction-specific portraits.
